issues.detail: The Hebrew 'בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע וְשֶׁבַע' means 'Beer-sheba and Sheba' (two distinct place names: Beer-sheba and Sheba). The Chinese renders it as '別是巴、別是巴' (Beer-sheba, Beer-sheba), duplicating the same name instead of translating the second 'שֶׁבַע' as a separate place name 'Sheba' (示巴). This changes the meaning by omitting the second distinct location.
